- We see heavy tailing on decode step; GPU kernel stalls around token 8-12 for longer sequences.
- Scheduling shows increased preemption events in the dedicated pool between 00:45–02:15 UTC (coincident with the deploy).
- Model version metadata confirms qprofile-compact was selected; kernel choice switched to int8-atten-opt (we normally use fp16-atten for this workload).

Actions I'm starting:
1) Enable kernel-level tracing on a small subset of the nodes serving Magnus (will add trace ids to the ticket).
2) Spin a canary with v5.1 and v5.2 side-by-side using identical input distribution to reproduce latency and quality metrics.
3) If kernel fallback explains the latency we can roll a micro-patch to force fp16 path for the affected shard.

If we can't get a fast mitigation within 2–3 hours I recommend a controlled rollback to v5.1 for Magnus pool to restore SLOs while we continue deep-dive.
